params.body:
Follows #75. The photo could be enlarged and the lightbox could be closed, but neither said so: the only cue to open was a zoom cursor, which a phone never shows, and the only way out was the dark backdrop or Escape, with nothing on screen that named it.

## What changed

- **"Vergroten" on the photo.** A small label with an expand icon in the corner of the photo, in the register of the field labels, on the full order page, in the order window and on the public frame page, which shares the lightbox. It is part of the link, not a second control.
- **"Sluiten" in the lightbox.** A close button top right, with the cross and the word, in the language of the page (the link carries it in `data-close`). Backdrop and Escape still close.
- One new icon (`expand`) in the inline set; translations for the two words in en, fr and de.

## Verification

- `ConfiguratorTest`: the order page and the order window carry the label and the close word; the lightbox builds the close button from it.
- Preview in headless Chromium at 1280px and 390px: label on the photo, close button in the lightbox, on the page and in the order window, no page errors. Screenshots are in the session.
- Pint, PHPStan and the suite pass. `BuildStampTest` fails in a git worktree only; it passes in CI.
params.title: Say that the photo enlarges and how the lightbox closes
